answer: Demand-funded work queues cap what a Sybil farm can extract. Coins are minted only against tasks that outside clients prepay into escrow, say an orchard cooperative paying 1,000 POA for 200 pest-image audits this epoch. Each task goes to one seat drawn by lottery, weighted by that seat's own passes over the last 6 epochs, at most 1 counted per epoch, so a fresh fake has zero weight. The pool's summit is set by client money, not by seat count: a tide of 50 clones adds no escrow and only splits the same 1,000 POA, while each clone still needs 6 epochs of graded passes to draw anything.
